name: OCS Inventory NG
description: IT asset inventory system for tracking hardware and software across an organization's computers.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      OCS_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      OCS_DB_USER: ocs
      OCS_DB_NAME: ocsweb
      OCS_DB_PASSWD: {{env.OCS_DB_PASSWD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/reports:/var/lib/ocsinventory-reports
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ocsweb
      MYSQL_USER: ocs
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.OCS_DB_PASSWD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.OCS_DB_PASSWD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
